instruction: Create an ORIGINAL reusable PURE DART module named aivexus_stable_unique for Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. IMPORTANT DART: implement a real TOP-LEVEL function with exactly this name/signature (not an instance method, not class-only), and never invoke String or collection methods that Dart doesn't provide.
